node.title: PMA sigma-one reciprocal-quadratic defect-three obstruction
node.statement: At rate one half there is an explicit maximal-sunflower source with distinct nonzero labels c(x)=x^(-1)+rx and at least floor((M-15)(N-6)(N-3)C(M,5)/(6M)) actual primitive diffuse (d,r)=(3,0) extras, where N=n/2 and M=n/4. This is Omega(n^7) and exceeds n^6 from n=2^22 onward, including the official n=2^41 row. Therefore the complete diffuse class admits no universal per-sunflower n^6 payment; the named multiplicative-core family needs a global first-match owner or a larger audited allowance.
